description: This file defines the TwigFilter class, which represents a template filter in the Twig templating engine. It manages filter options, safe output evaluation, and filter metadata.

classes.name: TwigFilter
classes.description: Represents a template filter in the Twig templating engine, managing filter behavior, safety, and options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TwigFilter with a name, callable, and options, merging default safety and node class options.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'filter' indicating this is a filter type.

methods.name: getSafe
methods.description: Determines the safe output options for the filter, based on the 'is_safe' or 'is_safe_callback' options.

methods.name: getPreservesSafety
methods.description: Returns the 'preserves_safety' option if set; otherwise, an empty array.

methods.name: getMinimalNumberOfRequiredArguments
methods.description: Calculates the minimal number of required arguments for the filter, adding one to the parent's value.
